table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Customer=A.name,
	AliasName=A.aliasname,
	Address=C.Address1,
	documentcode=V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Debit,
	credit= V.Credit,
	remarks = V.Remarks,
	openbalance=(SELECT isnull(sum(vv.debit-vv.credit), 0) FROM virtualgl vv 
					WHERE vv.acccode=A.acccode and vv.date < :ar_startdate),
	AreaCode=Ar.AreaCode,
	Area=Ar.Name,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.VoucherCode
FROM
	(SELECT * FROM VirtualGL 
	WHERE date >= :ar_startdate and date <= :ar_enddate) V,
	Accounts A, 
	Customer C, 
	Area Ar
WHERE
	C.AreaCode IN (:ar_areacode) and
	C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode and
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode and
	(V.AccCode = A.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = A.AccCode ) and
	V.date >= :ar_startdate and V.date <= :ar_enddate
UNION ALL
SELECT
	Customer=A.name,
	AliasName=A.aliasname,
	Address=C.Address1,
	documentcode=V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Credit,
	credit= V.Debit,
	remarks = Case debit 
			When 0 then 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
			Else 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))),
	openbalance=(SELECT isnull(sum(vv.debit-vv.credit), 0) 
					FROM virtualgl vv 
					WHERE vv.acccode=A.acccode and vv.date < :ar_startdate),
	AreaCode=Ar.AreaCode,
	Area=Ar.Name,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.VoucherCode
FROM 
	(SELECT * FROM VirtualGL WHERE date >= :ar_startdate and date <= :ar_enddate) V,
	Accounts A, 
	Customer C, 
	Area Ar
WHERE
	V.AlternateAccCode = A.AccCode and
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode and
	C.AreaCode IN (:ar_areacode) and
	C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
ORDER BY
	A.name, 
	A.aliasname, 
	date, 
	type, 
	VRow

objects.name: c_balance
objects.expression: ABS(max( openbalance  for group 1) + cumulativeSum( debit - credit for group 1 ))

objects.name: t_5
objects.text: if(max( openbalance  for group 1) + cumulativeSum( debit - credit for group 1 ) < 0, 'Cr', '')
